# MSM Sample Mod

A Fabric mod for Minecraft 26.3, generated by MCSuperMods 0.6.0 ("Export Java project"). This project is not managed by MCSuperMods: it is yours to edit, and edits do not flow back into the MCSuperMods project. Exporting again writes a new project; it does not update this one.

The generated Java does what the MCSuperMods runtime (`msm_runtime`) does with the same definitions, without depending on it.

## Build

You need JDK 25. Then run:

```
./gradlew build
```

(on Windows, `gradlew.bat build`). The mod jar is `build/libs/msm_sample_mod-1.0.0.jar`; put it in the `mods` folder of a Fabric 26.3 installation with Fabric API.

## Structure

| Path | Contents |
|---|---|
| `src/main/java/msm_sample_mod/MsmSampleMod.java` | The mod initialiser: registers the blocks, items and entities |
| `src/main/java/msm_sample_mod/ModBlocks.java`, `ModItems.java`, `ModEntities.java` | Registration, one constant per block, item and entity type |
| `src/main/java/msm_sample_mod/block/`, `item/`, `entity/` | Classes for content with behaviour (events, redstone, AI goals, animations) |
| `src/main/java/msm_sample_mod/Actions.java` | The event actions (functions, particles, block states, items, sounds) |
| `src/main/java/msm_sample_mod/client/` | The client entrypoint and GeckoLib models (projects with entities) |
| `src/main/resources/fabric.mod.json` | Mod metadata |
| `src/main/resources/assets/`, `data/` | Models, textures, language files, loot tables, functions and other pack files |
| `msm.export.json` | Which MCSuperMods version and target produced this project |

Files that did not exist for this project (for example `ModEntities.java` without entities) are not written.
